slack_thread.text: Incident: the release notifier posted twice to #C-RELEASES. Intended operation_id is release-note-v42. Intended text: "Release v42 shipped to production." chat.postMessage returned an error after the client had already forwarded the request. A teammate retried the same operation_id. We now have two messages.
Proposed patch: search conversations.history and retry if the page is empty. That went green on ordinary unit tests.

linear_issue.title: Release note must be posted exactly once per operation
linear_issue.description: Acceptance: destination C-RELEASES; operation_id release-note-v42; body exactly 'Release v42 shipped to production.'; at most one message for that operation. If the write was dispatched and the ack was lost, do not send that operation_id again. If the adapter shows the request never left the client, send once. A later announcement with a new operation_id may reuse the same body. Empty history pages are not proof of absence after a dispatched write.

fault_label: injected at the test transport: drop acknowledgement after forward vs block dispatch. Not a live Slack 408 outage.
